newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy treasury, budget mins to merge this year.
newsitem.headline: Italy treasury, budget mins to merge this year.

text.p: Italy intends to merge the treasury and budget ministries into one body by the end of the year, the treasury ministry said in a statement on Friday.
It said approval by parliament this week of reforms to state accounting procedures would allow the ministries to merge "on an organisational level as well" by the end of 1997.

Carlo Azeglio Ciampi was named Treasury and Budget Minister when the centre-left government was appointed last May, unifying responsibility for portfolios that had been held by separate ministers in most previous administrations.
The two ministries, however, remain separate entities with their own bureaucracies.
